content: Tauri v2 stable (current v2.10.1, released March 2026). Scaffold: npm create tauri-app@latest -- --template react-ts. Uses Vite as the bundler. Tauri IPC: use invoke() for commands, Channel API for streaming (emit events from Rust to frontend). emit() on AppHandle for broadcast events. For high-throughput streaming like pty output, prefer Channel API over individual emit calls.
